title: Bacterial transformation (heat shock)
summary: Introduce plasmid DNA into chemically-competent E. coli via heat shock. The cloning workhorse step.

reagents.name: Chemically-competent E. coli (DH5α, NEB Stable, etc.)

hazardsMd: Heat block at 42 °C will burn briefly. Bunsen flame for plate spreading is open fire; tie back hair and clear flammables.
contentUndergrad:
## What's happening
Brief 42 °C heat shock + ice gradient permeabilizes the bacterial membrane just enough for plasmid to slip in. Recovery in non-selective media lets the cells express the antibiotic resistance before plating on selective agar.

steps.title: Thaw competent cells on ice
steps.instructionMd: Thaw a 50 μL aliquot of competent cells on ice for 10 min — never at room temp. Pre-warm SOC/LB to 37 °C. Pre-warm a selective agar plate to 37 °C (~10 min in incubator).
steps.verificationMd: Cells fully thawed, slightly cloudy. SOC/LB warm to touch. Plate dry (no condensation on lid).

steps.title: Add DNA, incubate on ice
steps.instructionMd: Add 1-5 μL plasmid DNA (1-100 ng) to cells. Flick tube gently — do not pipette mix. Incubate on ice 30 min.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Vortexing kills competent cells. Always flick or pipette extremely gently.
steps.verificationMd: DNA droplet visibly mixed into cell suspension. Tube returned to ice promptly.

steps.title: Heat shock
steps.instructionMd: Transfer tube DIRECTLY from ice to a 42 °C water bath or heat block for exactly 30-45 seconds (kit-dependent). Then DIRECTLY back to ice for 2 min.
steps.verificationMd: Time at 42 °C kept under 60 s. No temperature stalling between heat block and ice.

steps.title: Recover in SOC
steps.instructionMd: Add 950 μL pre-warmed SOC. Incubate 37 °C, 200 rpm shaking, for 1 hour (longer for low-copy plasmids or selection beyond ampicillin).
steps.verificationMd: Tube placed at the right shaker setting. Timer set for 60 min.

steps.title: Plate on selective agar
steps.instructionMd: Spread 50-200 μL onto pre-warmed selective plate (depending on expected efficiency). Let absorb 5 min, invert plate, incubate 37 °C overnight.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Wick the spreader through ethanol + flame between plates if reusing.
steps.verificationMd: Liquid fully absorbed before inversion. Plate labeled with date, plasmid, antibiotic, your name. Ready to image colonies the next morning.
